outfit:
Focus ONLY on the clothing / outfit / dress visible in this image. Ignore the person wearing it, the background, and everything else. Describe the outfit with maximum precision for use in an AI image generation prompt. Cover:
- Exact garment type(s)
- Precise color(s) and any pattern
- Fabric texture and finish
- Fit and silhouette
- Neckline
- Sleeves
- Length
- Notable details: cutouts, embroidery, buttons, zippers, belts, ties, ruffles, sequins
- Footwear if visible
- Accessories that are part of the outfit
Output as one dense descriptive paragraph with no bullet points or headers.
_note: Exact prompts as they existed before caption/outfit were extracted from studio/routes.py into shared modules. Generated by executing the original code, not by hand. tests/test_caption_prompts.py asserts the current implementation still produces these byte for byte.
